metaTitle: Valdivia Bike Fest | Mountain bike race in Valdivia
metaDescription: Valdivia Bike Fest: a mountain bike race in Valdivia, Chile. Learn about the event, explore the route, check the schedule, and get ready to register.
intro: A mountain bike competition between forest, water, and city. Save your place at the start line and know the terrain before you arrive.

evento.lead: Valdivia Bike Fest brings together those who come for the challenge and stay for the landscape. Everything you need to prepare for your race, in one place.

items.text: XCO and XCC circuits in Valdivia.
A community that starts before pedaling.

tabs.label: XCO
tabs.title: XCO
tabs.description: Cross-Country Olympic with start and finish at the ASENAV Sports Complex. A ~3.6 km circuit with ~170 m of climbing per lap, one feed zone and spectator sectors.

tabs.label: XCC
tabs.title: XCC
tabs.description: Short Track at the ASENAV Sports Complex: ~0.81 km and ~18 m of elevation per lap, lasting ~20 minutes. 2026 reference: ~10 laps Elite Men and ~9 Elite Women.

ruta.footerNote: Schedule and lap counts per category are defined at the technical meeting.

resultados.copy: When the race ends, find your time, your category, and where you placed in the pack. The official board awaits you on a single screen.

valdivia.copy: A city of rivers, rain, and deep green. Turn your race into a getaway and discover the place that gives this experience its character.
